grounding.states: S&P/TSX Composite closed Friday Oct 9 at 35,664.62, up 519.24 points (1.477%)
grounding.from: The S&P/TSX Composite Index closed at 35,664.62, up 519.24 points (1.477%).

grounding.states: Friday's rise was driven by weak September jobs data (loss of 68,300 jobs vs forecast gain of 9,200), lowering rate-hike expectations
grounding.from: Canada's September employment loss of 68,300 jobs, against a forecast gain of 9,200, reduced expectations for a Bank of Canada rate hike, Reuters reported.

value.answer: TSX is closed today for Thanksgiving, so no trading. Friday it closed at 35,664.62, up 519.24 points (1.48%), after weak September jobs data eased rate-hike worries. Trading resumes tomorrow, Oct 13, at 9:30 a.m. ET.
